status: REVIEW VARIANT — the image-left brow completed by the D-158 mirroring on the D-189 baseline; not approved, not promotable

method.binding: D-158 (1)(b)–(h): the fully visible image-right brow is the shape source; it is mirrored about the face's MEASURED anatomical midline (not the canvas centre); afterwards only a small, mathematically described, reproducible adjustment is allowed (translation; a very small rotation and, only on documented need, a small uniform scale); freehand correction and non-linear deformation are not allowed; pixels in the hair-covered area are reconstructed and never described as observed; the brow is not shortened, moved or enlarged to show better under the hair.
method.sourceBrow: the D-189 browR layer (Northstar's own right brow with its cleaned edge), pixels with alpha >= 128 define its shape
method.observedBrow: the D-189 browL layer (Northstar's own visible left brow), pixels with alpha >= 128

axis.rule: the midpoint of the centroids of the two eye components (D-188 iris ∪ eyes-fixed, alpha >= 128, split at x = 510)
axis.note: D-158 measured 510.90 on its own segmentation of the original; it recorded that every axis candidate except the nose stroke lands the fit at the same absolute place, because the translation absorbs the axis

fit.order: lexicographic, as D-158: (1) fewest mirrored brow pixels on SAFE visible skin, (2) highest IoU with the observed brow, (3) smallest deviation |tx| + |ty| + |rotationDeg| + 100·|scale − 1|. IoU and recall are measured only where the brow is observable, i.e. outside D-188's missing-under-hair mask: the observed brow is truncated by the hair, so a whole-box IoU would reward shrinking the mirror (set after the first local run gave 0.567 against D-158's 0.938).
fit.safeSkin: original visible skin (D-188 skin-owned, class S/O, alpha >= 250, not reconstructed), eroded by 2 px for the ±1–2 px edge uncertainty

stages.name: translation + small rotation (only if translation leaves skin pixels)
+ small uniform scale (only if rotation still leaves skin pixels)

fit.resampling: inverse mapping with bilinear interpolation of premultiplied RGBA; rotation and scale about the mirrored brow's alpha centroid

method.completion: the completed brow = the observed brow over the fitted mirror, where the mirror contributes ONLY inside D-188's missing-under-hair mask and only where the observed brow has no pixel; every observed pixel is kept; nothing is added on visible skin
